## Scope

This inventory records historical manuscript evidence recovered from the
read-only University of Bath OneDrive legacy tree:

`Mech Eng/OHT data (Tobi Laux)/MAF_Bayesian-main-old/`

Nothing in that tree was moved, renamed, or modified. The non-suffixed folders
below match the manuscript; `_HEXCEL` and `_IFAVG` folders are separate
variants.

## Recovered evidence set

- 38 HDF5 MCMC result files
- 722 CSV files
- 1,232 figure files
- posterior notebooks linking principal results to HDF5 files
- prediction-replot notebooks containing RMSE and probability-area calculations
- complete no-bias, latent-`E_1`-bias, latent-angle-bias, and leave-one-out
  result families

## Canonical principal analyses

| Analysis | Notebook | Linked HDF5 result |
|---|---|---|
| No bias | `posterior_no_bias.ipynb` | `results_mcmc/no_bias_hv_2024_11_12_10_40_24_MAF_linear.h5` |
| Latent `E_1` bias | `posterior_bias_E1.ipynb` | `results_mcmc/bias_E1_hv_2024_11_12_12_16_12_MAF_linear.h5` |
| Latent loading-angle bias | `posterior_bias_alpha.ipynb` | `results_mcmc/bias_alpha_hv_2024_11_12_16_01_31_MAF_linear.h5` |

## Table provenance

| Manuscript table | Historical source | Verification |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `figures_no_bias/inference_theta_linear_stats.csv` | Exact reported values, including `E_1 = 152434.039` and standard deviation `2087.528` |
| 2 | `figures_no_bias/inference_hyper_linear_stats.csv` | Exact reported hyper-parameter values |
| 3 | `figures_no_bias/figure_replot_prediction.ipynb` | Printed RMSE/area values and calculation code match rounded manuscript values |
| 4 | `figures_bias_E1/inference_theta_linear_bias_E1_stats.csv` | Exact reported physical-parameter values |
| 5 | `figures_bias_E1/inference_b_linear_bias_E1_stats.csv` | Exact eight latent-bias values |
| 6 | `figures_bias_E1/figure_replot_prediction.ipynb` | Printed RMSE/area values match rounded manuscript values |
| 7 | `figures_bias_alpha/inference_theta_linear_bias_alpha_stats.csv` | Exact reported physical-parameter values |
| 8 | `figures_bias_alpha/inference_b_linear_bias_E1_stats.csv` | Historical alpha-bias summary; filename is incorrectly labelled `bias_E1` |
| 9 | `figures_bias_alpha/figure_replot_prediction.ipynb` | Printed RMSE/area values match rounded manuscript values |
| 10 | `figures_no_bias_leave_out/figure_replot_prediction.ipynb` | Complete three-withheld-angle calculations recovered |
| 11 | `figures_bias_E1_leave_out/figure_replot_prediction.ipynb` | Complete three-withheld-angle calculations recovered |

The prediction notebooks calculate RMSE with the square root of the summed
squared prediction error and probability area with Simpson integration of the
upper-minus-lower prediction interval.

## Exact embedded-figure matches

Checksum comparison established byte-identical matches between manuscript
embedded EMFs and these standalone historical figures:

| Manuscript result figure | Historical standalone figure |
|---:|---|
| 7 | `figures_no_bias/inference_theta_linear.emf` |
| 8 | `figures_no_bias/inference_hyper_linear.emf` |
| 10 | `figures_bias_E1/inference_theta_linear_bias_E1.emf` |
| 13 | `figures_bias_alpha/inference_theta_linear_bias_alpha.emf` |
| 17 | `figures_bias_E1_leave_out/leave_out_prediction_linear_90_135.emf` and other embedded leave-out panels |

The source families for Figures 6, 9, 11--12, and 14--16 are present, but some
exact final aggregate figure variants still need mapping.

## Remaining provenance risks

- The legacy tree is a loose historical snapshot and has no usable Git history,
  so the exact generating code commit is not traceable.
- Figure 5's Elementary Effects sensitivity-analysis source has not been found.
- Duplicate `_HEXCEL` and `_IFAVG` variants require deliberate canonicalisation.
- Three newer December 2025 `.nc` files named in retained analysis logs remain
  missing. They are a current-workflow reproducibility gap, not the source of
  the historical manuscript values.
- The recovered evidence does not make the manuscript submission ready; claims,
  comments, tracked changes, and scientific interpretation still require review.
